independence_evidence: Published by Prairie Fire Press, a Winnipeg literary non-profit (Wikipedia infobox: company Prairie Fire Press, based in Winnipeg, quarterly; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prairie_Fire_(magazine)). Not owned by any media group.
qualifies_reason: Long-running independent Canadian literary quarterly with 2025-26 and Fall 2026 issues listed on its own site.
what_it_is: A Canadian literary quarterly publishing new fiction, poetry and creative non-fiction, with themed issues and annual writing contests. It is printed in perfect-bound journal format and draws on writers from the Prairies and across Canada. Readers of literary journals and emerging Canadian writing are its audience.
